comment: Decision-group extensions (G27), merged into tools/lib/provenance-rules.mjs by BOTH enforcement layers. The built-in groups (rls-policy, guc-identity, token-verification, vector-index, llm-sampling, tuning-constants, cryptography) cover the stack-neutral security/LLM surface; this file carries the classes beyond them. The template SEEDS `mobile-security` — ATS/cleartext exceptions, Android permission strings, the runtimeVersion policy, and the updates URL are the locked mobile decision sites of the design record, so their constants carry a citation duty from day one. Add YOUR project's research/domain decision classes here too (a RAG chunk size, a similarity threshold, a sampling seed). Each group: {"key": "lowercase-kebab", "description": "...", "patterns": ["regex-source", ...]}. A group you add MUST also gain a corpus entry tagged with its key (the provenance gate's coverage lockstep enforces this): add that authority to tools/mcp/corpus/project.json, never to the harness-owned tools/mcp/corpus/index.json. MANDATORY AND ADVISORY (1.1.0): an uncited site in a mandatory class blocks the edit and reds the `provenance` gate; three built-in classes (vector-index, llm-sampling, tuning-constants) are advisory, so an uncited or wrongly grounded site there is reported (an ADVISORY line, a hook note) and reds nothing. Every group in this file is mandatory. An optional top-level "mandatory": ["<key>", ...] PROMOTES an advisory class back to mandatory (e.g. "mandatory": ["tuning-constants"]); a value that is not an array, or a key that is not a decision group, fails closed, and nothing in this file can demote a class. Write-guard-protected: extending the taxonomy is a reviewed act — and the seeded group is a floor, never remove it.

groups.description: Mobile transport/permission/update security — ATS and cleartext exceptions, Android permission strings, runtimeVersion policy, the EAS updates URL
